# Félix Tshisekedi in 2024: 2B.7 research note

## Bottom line
The 2024 record supports a **qualified yes** on pursuing ceasefires and peace talks, but **not** on achieving durable lawful settlement or reconciliation.

- **Positive:** Tshisekedi repeatedly engaged the Luanda and Nairobi tracks, backed ceasefires, met mediators, and presided over local peace agreements.
- **Negative / limiting:** the main eastern track still collapsed by year-end, fighting resumed, and the security posture remained heavily militarized and proxy-dependent.

## Accepted claims

- [Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix](/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** `2024-03-25`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi called for an urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability in eastern Congo and the region. This is direct evidence of pursuing peace talks when possible.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- [Les Téké et les Yaka s’engagent à mettre fin aux hostilités dans l’ouest de la Rdc](/actualite-detail/actualite/les_teke_et_les_yaka_sengagent_a_mettre_fin_aux_hostilites_dans_louest_de_la_rdc)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** `2024-04-06`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi presided over a local peace agreement in western DRC, with the parties committing to dialogue, mediation, and arbitration. This is strong evidence of confidence-building and lawful settlement behavior.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `2B.1`, `1B.4`

- [Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu](/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** `2024-08-12`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi backed the Luanda process, welcomed the 4 August ceasefire, and said his government was available for next negotiation steps. This is direct evidence that he pursued a ceasefire when one was on the table.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- [Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E. Mr. Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo](/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french)  
  - **Publisher:** UN Secretary-General  
  - **Date:** `2024-09-24`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** The UN said Tshisekedi discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts with the Secretary-General. This independently confirms ongoing diplomatic engagement rather than refusal to negotiate.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- [Programme de désarmement et démobilisation : une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale](https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/)  
  - **Publisher:** ACP  
  - **Date:** `2024-03-22`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** The government framed P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and cohesion program intended to restore state authority where absent. This is relevant confidence-building / post-conflict institutional work, though not a settlement itself.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `1B.6`, `1B.4`

## Evidence cutting against or limiting the claim

- [Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say](https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** `2024-07-17`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported that the government relied on Wazalendo militias, the army had no control over them, and discipline was weak. Tshisekedi reportedly told them to be brought in line, but the dependence on proxies shows the peace track coexisted with unstable force structures.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `1B.6`, `1B.7`, `1B.3`

- [Congo and Rwanda say peace talks in Angola will not take place](https://theprint.in/world/congo-and-rwanda-say-peace-talks-in-angola-will-not-take-place/2404370/)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** `2024-12-15`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported the planned Angola summit collapsed after deadlock over direct DRC-M23 dialogue. This is the clearest sign that Tshisekedi’s peace-track efforts did not produce a durable lawful settlement by year-end.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- [Fighting resumes in eastern Congo, army and M23 say](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Fighting-resumes-in-eastern-Congo-army-and-M23-say-48510597/)  
  - **Publisher:** Reuters  
  - **Date:** `2024-12-03`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported renewed fighting in eastern Congo in violation of the ceasefire. This indicates the ceasefire / confidence-building framework was fragile and not yet durable.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- [Face à la presse, le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC](/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc)  
  - **Publisher:** Présidence RDC  
  - **Date:** `2024-02-23`  
  - **Claim-level summary:** Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and force-forward approach to eastern security. This weakens a strong 2B.7 reading because it shows peace efforts coexisting with a militarized posture rather than a consistently settlement-oriented one.  
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`, `2B.1`, `1B.3`, `1B.7`

## Search gap
- I found **no clear evidence** of a final post-conflict reconciliation process or durable lawful settlement achieved in 2024.
- I also found **no evidence** of a comprehensive confidence-building package beyond the ceasefire, mediation, and DDR messaging.
- So the best defensible conclusion is: **yes on pursuing ceasefires and talks, no on durable settlement success**.
